:::{#exm-ref-rd}

#### Switching the reference group in a risk difference

In @exm-RD, we estimated that the [risk difference](#def-RD) of MI for OC versus non-OC is:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\delta(OC, \neg OC)
&= `r rd_OC`
\end{aligned}
$$

In comparison, the risk difference for non-OC versus OC is:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\delta(\neg OC, OC)
&= \ph(MI|\neg OC) - \ph(MI|OC)\\
&= `r p_MI_nOC` - `r p_MI_OC`\\
&= `r p_MI_nOC - p_MI_OC`\\
&= -\delta(OC, \neg OC)
\end{aligned}
$$

as @thm-rd-switch-ref states.

:::
